first_step_test: The first saved crop shows a long rounded handle with its narrow metal bolster already fitted at the right; these two connected forms set the horizontal pose and a fixed hinge for the later blade.

source.notes: Two generated six-panel sheets shifted the handle/hinge and were preserved as rejected iterations. The approved five-panel contact sheet derives cumulative raster crops by removing later pencil layers from one generated master, with its generated finish retained.

final_elements.name: wooden handle outline
final_elements.description: Long rounded handle on the left, horizontal with a gently bowed top and bottom, ending at a squared right hinge.

final_elements.name: metal bolster band
final_elements.description: Narrow vertical metal band wrapping the right end of the handle.

final_elements.name: pivot circle
final_elements.description: Single small pivot circle centered on the metal bolster.

final_elements.name: open blade outline
final_elements.description: One tapered blade extending right from the fixed pivot, straight back above and curved cutting edge below, ending in one point.

final_elements.name: blade nail nick
final_elements.description: One short curved nail nick near the base of the blade.

final_elements.name: handle rivets
final_elements.description: Exactly two small rivets along the left wooden handle.

final_elements.name: wood grain strokes
final_elements.description: Exactly three short flowing grain marks following the handle.

final_elements.name: ground shadow
final_elements.description: One broken pale ground shadow beneath the handle and blade.

frames.visible_job: Draw one long handle and its narrow right-end metal band.
frames.instruction: Draw a long narrow handle across the lower middle, rounded on the left and squared at the right. Wrap a narrow metal bolster band around its right end; leave the page open to the right for the blade.

frames.visible_job: Add one pivot circle in the bolster and two small handle rivets.
frames.instruction: Center a small pivot circle inside the metal band. Add exactly two smaller rivet circles along the wooden handle, one near the rounded left tip and one halfway toward the bolster.

frames.visible_job: Extend one tapered blade rightward and place its short nail nick.
frames.instruction: From the bolster, pull a nearly straight blade back to the right and taper it to a point. Curve the lower cutting edge back to the hinge, then add one short dark nail nick near the upper blade edge.

frames.step_name: Add grain and a ground shadow
frames.visible_job: Add flowing wood grain and a broken shadow below the knife.
frames.instruction: Follow the handle with three broad, wavering wood-grain strokes. Sketch one broken graphite shadow directly below the handle and blade, leaving the blade point and all three fasteners clear.

final_step.visible_job: Shade established wood and metal forms without adding structural contours.
final_step.instruction: Layer muted warm brown on the existing wooden handle and soft graphite along the metal bolster and blade underside. Deepen the same rivets, nick, and shadow without adding new parts.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop has a long rounded handle and a narrow bolster fixed at its right end. Its simple horizontal pose leaves blank paper to the right for the blade; no detached guide is present.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I inspected the five saved JPGs in order. The handle ends, bolster, pivot, two handle rivets, blade tip, and nail nick remain in their positions. The layer-removal fallback uses one generated raster master for the outline stages. No temporary guides are used. The finish only colors and shades existing forms.

transitions.observed_addition: The unchanged rounded handle and right bolster gain one circle inside the band and exactly two smaller rivets, one near the left end and one at mid-handle.
transitions.instruction_match: The second saved crop follows the instruction for one pivot and two spaced handle fasteners.

transitions.observed_addition: The same two rivets and pivot persist; one slim blade extends from the band to a single right point, with a dark short nail nick near its upper edge.
transitions.instruction_match: The third saved crop matches the rightward blade contour and one nail nick while preserving the handle hardware.

transitions.observed_addition: The handle, bolster, three fasteners, blade point, and nick persist. Three flowing grain strokes appear inside the handle and one broken shadow grows directly below.
transitions.instruction_match: The fourth saved crop matches the taught grain and shadow, without adding a new structural part.

transitions.observed_addition: The same outline and all three circles remain. Warm brown pencil fills the wood; soft graphite shades the same band and blade and darkens the existing ground shadow.
transitions.instruction_match: The finish follows the coloring and shading instruction; it introduces no new contour or hardware.
